g.text: Spatial Lineage: Known Graph + Learned Links
STGCN: local propagation on a known graph
Its T-GCN-T block injects adjacency W directly.
Source: Yu et al., IJCAI 2018, Fig. 2
Graph WaveNet: latent links from data
Node embeddings recover links omitted by the prior graph.
Source: Wu et al., IJCAI 2019, Fig. 3
Why it worked: the 32×32 grid has stable neighbors; the explicit graph narrows search while the adaptive graph adds non-local links.
